signal: Sonatype named Vertosoft a value-added distributor to expand reach across federal, state and local government agencies

email.subject1: a signal play for Sonatype federal
email.body1:
Antoine, saw Sonatype added Vertosoft as a distributor to widen reach across federal, state, and local agencies.

Expanding the federal contract surface usually means more in-market agencies than the team can work before they cool off, and that is where covered accounts slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Sonatype's federal motion off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your federal number
email.body2:
Antoine, quick follow-up for the federal team.

With a new distributor in play, the addressable agency list grows faster than rep capacity, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and the quarter turns into recovery mode.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sonatype federal needs to close that gap this quarter, and where it breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Antoine, last bit of proof for your team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sonatype's federal reply rate likely compares to peer security vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Antoine, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling federal pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters right after a channel expansion, and I know standing up new distributor motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a federal sales motion? I will tailor it to Sonatype either way.
